answer: Trust edges decay unless both ends keep working, and an edge unlocks only after thirty days of continuous uptime. No identity audits its own recruit, so a sponsor cannot grade the account it created. The delta matters more than the absolute score: a farm's edges fade faster than an honest agent's because it cannot afford uptime on every branch, and its horizon of trusted peers shrinks with each idle week. One whisper of collusion voids the edge, and an oasis of linked accounts drains itself.
